rows.text: The single biggest mistake a new pilot makes with Gaddock Teeg is assuming his restriction only hurts your opponents. Gaddock Teeg stops *all* players—including you—from casting noncreature spells with mana value 4 or greater, or spells with {X} in their mana costs. Running staples like Smothering Tithe, Chord of Calling, Finale of Devastation, or The One Ring will leave dead cards stranded in your hand. Instead, this list ensures that *every* noncreature spell in the ninety-nine costs 3 or less with no {X}, while all your high-end finishers (Elesh Norn, Craterhoof Behemoth, Moonshaker Cavalry) are creature spells that bypass Teeg's restriction completely.

guide.title: The Kithkin Advisor and the stax lockdown

rows.name: Gaddock Teeg
rows.text: Cast for {G}{W}. Shuts off all noncreature spells with mana value 4 or greater and any noncreature spells with {X} in their mana costs, locking out board wipes, extra turns, and planeswalkers.

rows.text: Locks out commanders from the command zone, flashback spells from graveyards, and cascade, discover, or exile casts. Combined with Teeg, opponents cannot play commanders or sweepers.

rows.name: Archon of Emeria
rows.text: Restricts each player to casting only one spell each turn while forcing opponents' nonbasic lands to enter tapped, completely suffocating storm and high-tempo decks.

rows.text: Taxes all noncreature spells by {1}, punishing early cantrips, mana rocks, and cheap removal.

rows.name: Aven Interrupter
rows.text: Flash flying bird that exiles a spell on the stack into plot with a {2} mana tax, and taxes all spells cast from graveyards and exile by {2}.

rows.name: Blind Obedience
rows.text: Two-mana enchantment that forces all opposing creatures and artifacts to enter tapped, turning off hasty attackers and instant mana rocks.

rows.name: Deafening Silence
rows.text: One-mana enchantment allowing each player to cast only one noncreature spell each turn.

rows.name: Aven Mindcensor

rows.name: Leonin Arbiter

rows.name: Archivist of Oghma
rows.text: Flash hatebear that draws a card and gains 1 life whenever an opponent searches their library.

rows.name: Rest in Peace

rows.name: Spirit of the Labyrinth

rows.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth

rows.name: Stony Silence
rows.text: Two-mana enchantment that shuts down all artifact activated abilities.

rows.name: Kataki, War's Wage

rows.name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
rows.text: Shuts off all activated abilities of creatures opponents control, blanking mana dorks and creature combo pieces.

rows.name: Sanctum Prelate

rows.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned + Walking Ballista
rows.text: Heliod grants lifelink to Walking Ballista for {1}{W}. Remove a +1/+1 counter from Ballista to deal 1 damage to an opponent. Lifelink gains 1 life, triggering Heliod to put a +1/+1 counter back on Ballista. Repeat infinitely for lethal table burn. (Note: Collector Ouphe or Stony Silence shuts off Ballista's activated ability, so sacrifice or remove them before executing).
In accordance with Bracket 3 rules, this two-card combo is reserved for turn 6 or later. Early turns focus on establishing hatebears, locking opponent mana, and applying combat pressure.

Look for opening hands with 2 to 3 lands, a 1-drop mana dork (Birds of Paradise, Llanowar Elves, Avacyn's Pilgrim, Delighted Halfling), and at least one impactful turn-2 hatebear or tutor (Gaddock Teeg, Thalia, Drannith Magistrate, Eladamri's Call).
On turn 1, play a land and deploy a mana dork.

On turn 2, deploy Gaddock Teeg or a targeted hatebear based on what your opponents are playing (Drannith Magistrate against commander-centric pods, Collector Ouphe against artifact ramp, Thalia against spellslinger).

On turns 3 through 5, assemble your lock using Survival of the Fittest, Recruiter of the Guard, or Yisan to tutor the exact silver bullet needed to shut down the table, while holding up protection (Mother of Runes, Selfless Spirit, Heroic Intervention).

On turn 6 or later, execute your finish by dropping Craterhoof Behemoth, Moonshaker Cavalry, or triggering Beastmaster Ascension for an overwhelming combat alpha strike, or tutor up the Heliod + Walking Ballista combo to burn out the table.
